description: Header file defining the ProofSourceChromium class, which implements the quic::ProofSource interface for QUIC protocol proof source handling, including certificate and key initialization, proof generation, and TLS signature computation.

classes.name: ProofSourceChromium
classes.description: Implements the quic::ProofSource interface for Chromium's QUIC proof source, managing certificates, keys, and cryptographic proofs.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the proof source with certificate chain, private key, and optional signed certificate timestamp.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates cryptographic proof for a given server and client address, hostname, and configuration.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain associated with the proof source.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature using the proof source.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the ticket crypter used for encrypting/decrypting tickets.

methods.name: GetProofInner
methods.description: Internal method to generate proof with detailed parameters.
